name: Soyuz TMA-1
about: Soyuz TMA-1 (2002-050A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2002 Oct 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2002 Nov  6), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
